entropy.construct: Contextual entropy / context saturation + tool failure
entropy.telemetry: Cloud agent token use + failed/total tool calls
entropy.confidence_rule: high if tokens+tools observed; low if imputed

opacity.telemetry: ΔLOC, Δ complexity, files touched from git/GitHub API
opacity.missing_behavior: Impute from PR file count alone if available
opacity.confidence_rule: high with full diff stats; medium with LOC only

blast_radius.missing_behavior: Declare missing; do not invent coupling
blast_radius.confidence_rule: high with cached graph; none if graph absent

spec_ambiguity.telemetry: 1 - mean pairwise plan similarity, or spec:raw label
spec_ambiguity.missing_behavior: Use label proxy (raw=0.7, refined=0.2) at medium confidence
spec_ambiguity.confidence_rule: high with embedding plans; medium with label proxy

factors.construct: Recovery control contributing to R(t): spec_refinement
factors.normalization: activity clipped to [0,1]; weight w_f units 1/time
factors.confidence_rule: high when toggle and activity both observed
